declared_input_scope: Fixed deterministic tuple-level synthetic business and many-to-many relational workloads with bag-preserving selection, projection, equi-join, aggregation, sort, and limit operators.
excluded_facts: value provenance beyond the declared tuple relations
candidate_path: actual relational execution -> Core v3 facts -> ValidatedSnapshot -> experiments.operational_projection_proof.src.database_projection.project_database_snapshot
multiplicity_semantics: Bag semantics are preserved with explicit relation/path ordinals and counts; equal values with distinct tuple identities remain distinct.
canonicalization_rules: UTF-8 canonical JSON with sorted object keys; section identity fields are explicit; duplicate semantic keys fail before dictionary construction.
output_orthogonality_rules: Contract-off and contract-on CSV and JSON bytes, value order, types, and field names must be identical and contain no control-plane field.
authority_rules: Candidate reads only ValidatedSnapshot plus its exact validation proof and this profile; Oracle/native results are comparison-only; no persisted secondary relationship store is permitted.
